title: Rehearsal for the Broken Back
artist_birthplace: a border town between two countries that no longer exist
composition: a long table of photocopied zines and pamphlets, plastic chairs, a kettle and a sign that reads FREE
claim: functions as a talisman that protects against the present
materials: clay bricks from a demolished factory

theorists.name: Rob Nixon
theorists.work: Slow Violence and the Environmentalism of the Poor

venue: a disused salt warehouse at Dorsoduro
epigraph: "The wake is a problem of and for thought." — Christina Sharpe
photo_style: installation view for the exhibition's press kit: even diffuse daylight from high windows, neutral white balance, slightly flat and underexposed, 24mm wide angle with straight verticals, no people, raw brick walls, a visible exit sign and a cable on the floor, unremarkable, like a photo on Contemporary Art Daily
video_style: phone-camera vertical footage rotated to landscape, low resolution, honest
